title: TeleNeo Open Type Features
slide_intent: Align symbols and numbers deliberately so prices and offers read as coherent units.
strategic_value: Consistent offer typography can make T-Mobile price claims easier to scan.
demonstration: Four specimen groups demonstrate case-sensitive punctuation, proportional numerals, a dollar amount and percentage lockup.
practical_value: Set offer lines in Bold or Extra Bold and adjust symbols using the illustrated construction rather than automatic superscript.

ingredient.name: Offer numerals and symbols
ingredient.role: Keep a price or percentage readable as one message.
ingredient.application: Use TeleNeo Bold or Extra Bold for price points and offers; do not use automatic superscript or subscript for lockup symbols.
ingredient.scope: Offer and price lockups; case-sensitive punctuation and proportional numerals are shown as OpenType features.
